verdict.rationale: The only evidence is a single docs mention of the first-party `mastra` CLI. Its `mastra dev` command launches Studio, where Knowledge is browsed, so an official CLI exists in the product's workflow. Nothing shows CLI commands for creating, editing, searching or scoping Knowledge pages. Missing for 10: Knowledge-specific CLI commands (list/read/write/search pages), CLI reference documentation, AI-agent-oriented CLI usage, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: To see the page, run `mastra dev`, open Studio and select **Knowledge**.
